rules.name: Sthana Balam determines polarity of outcomes
rules.description: If the dispositor of the Dasa Lord has high Sthana Balam (Exalted/Moolatrikona/Own), auspicious results materialize. If debilitated or heavily afflicted, adversity occurs.

rules.name: Retrograde Exception
rules.description: A retrograde planet reverses standard debilitation weakness and behaves as if moving backwards to connect with preceding planets.

rules.name: Rahu-Ketu Strength Transmission
rules.description: Rahu and Ketu absorb and amplify the strength of their dispositor and star lord. If the dispositor is exalted, own house, or retrograde, Rahu/Ketu Dasa yields massive fortune.
